notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title and description only; favicon and preview image are not collected.
REF-BM-03: Title is editable only after saving; description is never editable and there is no pre-save metadata editor.
REF-BM-04: URL and title can be edited and tags added, but description, note, and tag removal/editing are unavailable.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are prevented and highlighted, but the user is not taken into an edit flow for the existing bookmark.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title, description, and tags, but show generated initials instead of the collected favicon.
REF-BM-08: Bookmark cards and displayed URLs do not navigate to the original URL.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry has no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-11: Displayed tags cannot be selected to filter bookmarks.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title and tags only, not description, note, or URL.
REF-BM-14: #tag syntax is not parsed or supported.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are split into ordinary whitespace-delimited terms rather than exact-matched.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: No action can be applied to the full currently filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: No list sorting controls or sorting implementation exist.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshot preservation is absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-29: Saved search/tag bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are absent.
